title.narrative: Court-UNDP-LAO-01003118 - Strengthening case management and court procedures in the Lao PDR

description.narrative: Strengthening Case Management and Court Procedures in the Lao PDR for the criminal and civil chambers in selected courts in Vientiane and in cooperation with the Peoples Supreme Court. This includes enhancement of procedures as well as a comprehensive ToT Programme. Strengthening Case Management and Court Procedures in the Lao PDR for the criminal and civil chambers in selected courts in Vientiane and in cooperation with the Peoples Supreme Court. This includes enhancement of procedures as well as a comprehensive ToT Programme. The objective of the project is to, alongside the People’s Supreme Court (PSC), strengthen the court system in the Lao PDR to have an effective and accountable case management system that adopts best practices with a focus on the criminal and civil chambers in selected courts. Based on an assessment of existing case management practices and desk research on international standards, gaps will be identified. Based on those gaps, an action plan will be developed to strengthen existing procedures. Combined with a comprehensive training programme that will be rolled out within three courts in Vientiane, the project will increase the efficiency of case management and strengthen relevant accountability mechanisms. It is expected that through the comprehensive roll out of the training programme and its institutionalization within the PSC’s Training Institute’s agenda, that PSC will be able to scale up the programme to other provinces. The project is divided into the following two outputs. Output 1 – Case management procedures across all court levels are formalized, streamlined, and aligned with international best practices. Mapping of the case management chain and comparison with international best practices. Identification of gaps and development of a specific action plan to respond to existing challenges.
